# Spec: Browse users and roles

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/browse-users-and-roles.md)

**Start:** `/identity/directory`  
**Persona:** An administrator checking who can do what  
**Goal:** See the realm users with their roles and the application rights those roles grant.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Read the user table | The user ann is listed with the editor role and the docs.read right. |
| 2 | Read the role table | The viewer role is listed with no rights. |

Source: `e2e/journeys.ts` (journey `browse-users-and-roles`). Each expected result is asserted by the step's `run` function.
